description: Searches WhatsApp. With text or dates: finds messages, newest first, optionally only in one chat. With neither: lists chats (people and groups), newest first, optionally only those whose name or number matches person, or only unread ones; each with its id for whatsapp_read.

chat.description: Only messages in this chat (its id from whatsapp_find, or its name)

limit.description: At most this many (default 20 chats or 50 messages, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page

person.description: A person's or group's name, or a phone number

since.description: Only messages from this time on (ISO 8601)

name: whatsapp_find
title: Find WhatsApp Messages
